articles.title: NVIDIA CEO Tops Glassdoor’s 2026 List of Best CEOs
articles.summary: NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang has been named the top CEO on Glassdoor's 2026 list, achieving an impressive 99% employee approval rating, a testament to his leadership during a pivotal era of AI innovation and evolving workplace expectations. This recognition underscores the critical role of effective leadership in driving technological advancement and employee satisfaction in the competitive tech landscape.

articles.title: Fund backed by China memory giant YMTC invests in push for alternative chipmaking route
articles.summary: A venture capital fund backed by China's leading NAND flash memory producer, YMTC, has invested in SOI Micro, a domestic semiconductor manufacturer pioneering fully depleted silicon-on-insulator technology, marking a significant step towards establishing an alternative chipmaking ecosystem in China. This breakthrough is crucial as it enhances the country's semiconductor capabilities and reduces reliance on foreign technology amid ongoing global supply chain challenges.

articles.title: Bouncy brothers
articles.summary:
• The bouncy house business symbolizes the delicate balance between familial bonds and the pressures of entrepreneurial success.  
• As the brothers navigate challenges, their relationship reveals the complexities of loyalty and ambition intertwined.  
• The inflatable structure serves as a metaphor for the highs and lows of life, reflecting both joy and instability.  
• Ultimately, the brothers' journey prompts reflection on what it truly means to succeed in a world that often prioritizes profit over personal connections.

articles.title: Tencent capex jumps 176% on AI push as revenue beats estimates
articles.summary: Tencent's staggering 176% increase in capital expenditure to bolster its AI initiatives has not only propelled its revenue to an impressive 204.8 billion yuan, surpassing analyst expectations, but also underscores the company's commitment to leading the AI revolution in the tech industry. This strategic investment positions Tencent at the forefront of innovation, potentially reshaping its market influence and growth trajectory.

articles.title: Chinese AI start-up ModelBest, partner to Samsung and Huawei, launches pre-IPO process
articles.summary: Chinese AI start-up ModelBest has initiated its pre-IPO process, positioning itself to capitalize on the surging demand for compact AI models that operate locally on devices, while strategically addressing China's chip shortages with lightweight, optimized systems. This breakthrough could redefine the landscape of AI deployment in consumer technology and automotive sectors, potentially reshaping market dynamics in the face of geopolitical challenges.

articles.title: From assistance to execution: How enterprises put AI to work
articles.summary: OpenAI's latest research highlights a transformative shift in enterprise AI adoption, showcasing how companies are leveraging agentic AI tools like ChatGPT and Codex to not just assist but actively execute tasks, positioning themselves at the forefront of innovation and efficiency in the competitive landscape. This breakthrough underscores the potential for AI to redefine operational capabilities and drive significant business growth.
